home.whyBody1: SaaStainedNumbers was built to solve a simple problem: SaaS founders, operators, and financial analysts need fast, reliable financial math, without creating an account, sitting through a demo, or paying for a tool they'll use once. Every calculator on this site runs entirely in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
home.whyBody2: Each calculator is built from first principles using standard financial formulas. We document every formula with a worked example, benchmark results against industry-standard data, and cite our sources. No black-box estimates, just transparent math you can verify yourself.
home.whyBody3: We support the site through non-intrusive display ads and contextual affiliate links in FAQ sections. There are no paywalls, no sign-up walls, and no premium tiers. Every calculator is free, forever.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we handle your data. Short version: we don't collect your calculator inputs.
privacy.commitmentBody: SaaStainedNumbers is designed to respect your privacy. All calculator calculations happen entirely in your browser; your input data never leaves your device. We do not store, transmit, or process your calculator inputs on our servers.
privacy.notCollectedItem1: We do not collect or store your calculator inputs.
privacy.notCollectedItem2: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties.
privacy.notCollectedItem3: We do not use your data for advertising personalization or profiling.
privacy.cookiesBody1: We use localStorage in your browser to remember your theme preference (light/dark mode) and locale selection. This data stays on your device and is not sent to our servers.
privacy.cookiesBody2: We use Google Analytics (GA4) to understand aggregate traffic patterns. GA4 uses cookies to distinguish unique visitors. You can learn more about Google's data practices in Google's Privacy Policy.
privacy.thirdPartyIntro: We use the following third-party services:
privacy.thirdPartyItem3: Skimlinks - affiliate link monetization (some outbound links to retailers and service providers may be affiliate links)
privacy.thirdPartyItem4: Neon (PostgreSQL) - database hosting for user accounts and saved calculations (currently dormant; sign-in is disabled)
privacy.rightsBody: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or port your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at legal@saastainednumbers.com. We will respond within the timeframe required by applicable law.
privacy.retentionBody: We do not retain personal data beyond what is necessary for the operation of the service. Analytics data is retained for 26 months per Google Analytics default settings.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.whatAreCookiesBody: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser. They are commonly used to remember preferences, distinguish visitors, and analyze usage patterns.
cookies.localStorageBody: We use browser localStorage (not cookies) to store your theme preference (light/dark mode) and locale selection. This data never leaves your device and is not accessible to our servers or third parties.
cookies.analyticsBody: We use Google Analytics (GA4) to understand aggregate traffic patterns. GA4 uses cookies to distinguish unique visitors. You can opt out of Google Analytics by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.
